#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect quarterly_report.docx: extract it and report paragraph styles/text."""
import os
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = "unpacked"

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"


def local(tag):
    return tag.split("}")[-1] if tag.startswith("{") else tag


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        print(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found in {os.getcwd()}")
        sys.exit(1)

    if os.path.exists(OUT):
        shutil.rmtree(OUT)
    os.makedirs(OUT)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
        zf.extractall(OUT)
    print("Extracted to", OUT)
    print("Members:")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
        for n in zf.namelist():
            print("  ", n)

    # Parse document.xml (use ElementTree-like manual minidom walk)
    doc_path = os.path.join(OUT, "word", "document.xml")
    dom = minidom.parse(doc_path)

    # Fix namespace: minidom keeps prefixes as-is, tags like 'w:p'
    paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    print(f"\nTotal <w:p> paragraphs: {len(paras)}")

    style_counts = {}
    for i, p in enumerate(paras):
        pPr = None
        for child in p.childNodes:
            if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName == "w:pPr":
                pPr = child
                break
        style = None
        if pPr is not None:
            for child in pPr.childNodes:
                if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName == "w:pStyle":
                    style = child.getAttribute("w:val")
                    break
        style_counts[style] = style_counts.get(style, 0) + 1

        # text of paragraph
        texts = []
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
                if t.firstChild:
                    texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
        text = "".join(texts)
        print(f"[{i:3d}] style={str(style):12s} text={text[:80]!r}")

    print("\nStyle counts:", style_counts)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Show first 300 chars of raw document.xml to check declaration/format."""
with open("unpacked/word/document.xml", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    head = f.read(300)
print(repr(head))
